name: bq-abb
description: Analyse 2026 general expenditure tax in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for Caribbean Netherlands ABB, producer sales, taxable services, imported goods, island rates, passenger vehicles, producer input credit, reverse charge, small entrepreneur relief and filing records. Distinguishes the three islands, the USD 32,000 relief threshold and the separate USD 10,000 administration concession. Provides primary legislation, period corrections and hypothetical component calculations for a professional reviewer. This source-cited draft holds unresolved classifications, customs valuation, invoice rounding and actual return mapping. It does not establish a complete country pack or authorise filing or payment.
